# WebWallGL 2.1.0

Upstream: https://github.com/oneincase/webwallgl

Downloaded from https://registry.npmjs.org/webwallgl/-/webwallgl-2.1.0.tgz

Verified npm integrity: `sha512-6916s6/K9mQOtSuSQ9CUbMLSv37uZqzr+H205Av1HfHLXGsrg4kdqYrIanFF35L6u8RtEMioOivaddco/UT4RQ==`

The module is unmodified. Its MIT license is included in LICENSE. The unminified
module retains dependency copyright/license notices, including Mediabunny's MPL
2.0 notices (https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/). The source map includes source content.

This is a community compatibility renderer, not Wallpaper Engine itself. It
cannot guarantee identical rendering or support every Workshop scene. We use it
only on the isolated local wallpaper origin, with network access restricted to
that origin and without system audio/media integrations. Wallpaper files stay
in the user's Steam download directory and are not included in public exports.
